summary: Braskem S.A. and five subsidiaries filed an amendment to an out-of-court restructuring petition (recuperação extrajudicial) under Brazilian Law 11.101/05 in São Paulo court. Creditors holding 39.6% of subject debt signed the plan; Braskem committed to obtain majority consent within 90 days. The filing seeks to maintain a stay period suspending actions and executions against the group. This 6-K discloses ongoing debt renegotiation following mediation initiated June 24, 2026. Watch for creditor adhesions, plan approval, and potential equity dilution or asset sales as restructuring proceeds.
